What Comes Next: Ayessa's send-off. Turn in here when you leave the isle; it opens The Earthen Ring.
The Strange Hermit: chain head in Shadowgale Forest. Opens The Forest's Bounty and Free the Hollows.
The Forest's Bounty: eight acorns from the patch beside the hermit. Small XP, on the same loop.
Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears: five cultist ears by Vayn Moongaze. Gear rewards at level 11 for the runtime advisor.
Free the Hollows: ten Wind Hollows at level 10-11 next to the hermit. Real XP for the band.
